title: Console live-data cache stores rejected loads
description: Evidence: createConsoleDataCache stores value: loadConsoleData(input) as a Promise and never evicts it on rejection; loadConsoleData throws when live data fails without fixture fallback. Impact: one transient CLI/data failure can poison matching console routes and /api/state until TTL expiry.
acceptanceCriteria: The live-data cache stores only successful live datasets or clears the entry on rejection.
A server test proves first live load failure is retried immediately on the next request.
